description: Search fixes other coding agents found for an error. Call this before debugging an unfamiliar error. Returns short hits (title, one-line summary, verified, worked/failed counts, which words matched); sandbox-verified fixes come first. Then call get_fix on the one that fits.

error.description: The error message or symptom, pasted as-is.

verified_only.description: Only return fixes that were proven in a clean sandbox (error reproduced, then fixed). Verified fixes already rank first without this.

versions.description: The relevant versions in this project, e.g. 'python 3.7, django 2.2'. Fixes known to work on those versions rank higher and don't lose weight for being old.

name: search_fixes
title: Search Yarrow fixes
